description: A resolved config with an integral Decimal: answer_tolerance "10" (the clean answers are exact, so the scoring is clean's). Canonical JSON writes a Decimal as its exact string (R0.4.3), so the config hash covers "10"; a runner that wrote str(d.normalize()) ("1E+1") or an integral Decimal through float ("10.0") fails the hash oracle. The second Decimal shape beside decimal_trailing_zero: the config has one Decimal field, so each shape needs its own scenario.
exercises: R0.4.3 canonical JSON of an integral Decimal
